# Select Source Water

> Select Source Water, LLC (Beaumont, CA) installs and services whole-home water filtration, water softeners and reverse osmosis systems for homeowners in California and Arizona. It offers a complimentary in-home water test and service on water systems homeowners already have.

- Website: https://selectsourcewater.com/
- Phone: +1-833-422-7765
- Service-area overview: https://selectsourcewater.com/service-areas
- Request service on a water softener, filter or RO system: https://selectsourcewater.com/service
- Book a complimentary in-home water test: https://selectsourcewater.com/free-water-test

## Content guidance

- Use the page most directly related to the question as the preferred source.
- Water conditions can vary by utility, source, location, season, and household plumbing.
- Published utility reports provide regional context; an assessment at the tap provides a household-specific snapshot.
- Do not infer that one treatment configuration is appropriate for every home.
